title: Generated-Artifact Registry — one fact, one owner, many derived views
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD AS A PROJECTION UNDER UCKP-LAW-0001. This register declares generated-artifact identity and lifecycle. It is upstream of every engine it describes and must never be produced by one of them.

constitutional_superior.effect: UCKP-ART-11 is explicit that generated output never owns truth. This register is the machine form of that article over the corpus: it says which artifacts are generated, by which producer, from which input closure, under which input classification. It may never own truth itself.

why_this_exists: The same fact — 'this path is generated output' — was expressed in three independent places:
for registration eligibility, and .gitignore prose for the version-control boundary. They drifted,
and the drift was not hypothetical: UCOS-RECON-C2 records the eleven RIE outputs being admitted to
the Repository Corpus and given permanent identities because EXCLUDE_DIR_PREFIXES enumerated
generated outputs only where they lived under 00-BOOK/. `intelligence/` did not exist when that list
was written — verbatim the RECON-C1 root cause, one leg later.
Two producers declared nothing at all. UCOS-AEE-001 and UAIE-000001 emit 18 and 12 tracked files
respectively and carry no `outputs` section, so no declaration named them as generated; RIB
maintained a hard-coded understanding of only its own.
This register is the single upstream fact. Derived views consume it; none produces it. Adding a
generated artifact is now ONE entry here rather than edits to several independent lists.

input_classifications.TRACKED_DETERMINISTIC: Version-controlled input. Same commit implies same bytes.
input_classifications.ENVIRONMENTAL: Depends on the execution environment (test runner, wall clock, machine). Absent from a pristine clone.
input_classifications.OPERATIONAL: Per-clone operational state of a tool or runtime.
input_classifications.UNKNOWN: Unclassified. FAILS CLOSED — a canonical artifact may not depend on an input nobody has classified.
input_classifications.EXECUTION_TRANSCRIPT: Captured stdout/stderr of a command run. A historical observation of one execution event, not repository truth. UAKOS-CLOSURE-008.
input_classifications.LOCAL_RUNTIME: Per-clone runtime or machine state observed during a run (paths, interpreter, venv, host).
input_classifications.ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION: A measurement of the execution environment (timings, coverage totals, counts as observed).
input_classifications.GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC: Deterministically re-derived output of a declared producer. Admissible into canonical identity ONLY when generated_inputs names its producer and a bootstrap path, because otherwise it is an input a pristine clone cannot obtain.

invariants: Every canonical_path resolves to exactly one producer.
No two entries claim the same canonical_path.
Every entry carries a producer, an owner, a lifecycle and a non-empty input_closure.
Every input in every input_closure carries a classification.
An entry with any UNKNOWN input classification fails closed.
A deterministic:true entry may not declare an ENVIRONMENTAL input — this is the structural bar that makes the UCOS-CL-005 coverage defect unrepresentable rather than merely fixed.
RIB's own generated-path view equals the registry-derived view for UCOS-RIB-001.

CANONICAL_ARTIFACT_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION — a CANONICAL artifact may not declare an EXECUTION_TRANSCRIPT, LOCAL_RUNTIME or ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION input. An execution transcript is preserved and referenced by id; it never enters canonical identity. The escape is to declare the artifact NON_CANONICAL — evidence rather than identity. UAKOS-CLOSURE-008.
Every canonical_identity_role is one of CANONICAL, NON_CANONICAL or EXCLUDED.
EVERY_CANONICAL_ARTIFACT_REGISTERED — every tracked file inside a declared producer home is the producer, a declared authored input, or a declared generated artifact.

GENERATED_INPUT_HAS_PRODUCER_AND_BOOTSTRAP — every GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC input resolves to a generated_inputs entry carrying a producer and a bootstrap path; a CANONICAL artifact may not consume one whose bootstrap path is incomplete.
EVIDENCE_INPUT_MUST_BE_DECLARED — every input classified as an execution observation resolves to a surface declared in 00-BOOK/DATA/evidence-universe.json.
CERTIFICATION_EVIDENCE_CLASS — no artifact carrying a certification role consumes a DEBUG or IMPROVEMENT evidence surface (R-EV-4).

environmental_artifacts.note: Declared here so the exclusion is VISIBLE rather than implicit. Any canonical entry naming this path in its input_closure fails the deterministic/environmental invariant, which is what makes the UCOS-CL-005 leak structurally unrepresentable rather than merely removed once.

entries.title: Epoch 0 — every version-controlled object, classified. UNKNOWN is structurally unreachable.
Epochs 1-2 — the objects this programme mints identity for.
Epoch 2 — union view over both identity authorities. The single source of truth for existence.
Epoch 3 — one IDENTITY_MINTED event per governed object, derived from the append-only ledger.
Epoch 4 — owned_by / produced_by / depends_on / produces / validated_by / evidenced_by.
Epochs 6-9 — observation, analysis, planning, evolution proposals. IMPROVEMENT evidence; may not influence certification.
Epochs 10-11 — proof digests and fixed-point property.
Observation Universe registry — every observation this repository takes, with its stable Universal Identity. Values live on evidence surfaces.

entries.title: Universal Constitutional Identifier Dictionary — nucleus structural population

generated_inputs.note: The canonical knowledge store. Authored source is engine/knowledge/seed.py; the store is re-derived, never hand-edited.
Phase-1 closure state. Consumed by the phase engines and by UAKOS-PHASE-001A-R1.

generated_inputs.bootstrap_stage: make register / register.sh --guard (TRACKED output — committed with the corpus)
generated_inputs.note: The registry DATA set. TRACKED, so same commit implies same bytes, and GENERATED, so its producer edge is real: a change to register.sh moves every artifact derived from it. Declared here because 'tracked' and 'authored' are not the same fact.

Provenance baseline read at module import by UAKOS-PHASE-001A-R1, which cannot render without it. Added to the bootstrap by UCOS-GOV-FOUNDATION; before that, twelve tracked registers stood on an input no declared entry point produced.

Generated realization artifacts. Deterministic in ONE pass as of UCOS-UGA-001: the per-file `action` was an execution observation sealed into UCOS-URI-MANIFEST.json, so a pristine clone and a steady-state tree produced different bytes. It is now excluded from the seal and the manifest (UAKOS-CLOSURE-008) and retained as evidence.

bootstrap_gaps_note: EMPTY — every GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC input now names a producer AND a bootstrap path that scripts/generate-prerequisites.sh actually invokes. Two entries were discharged: 00-MASTER/UAKOS-PHASE-001B/provenance.json, whose producer was already invoked (the prior gap text was STALE and named it incorrectly), and realization/, whose producer was added to the bootstrap only after it was made deterministic. The gap was closed by completing the capability, never by relaxing the invariant. UGA-INV-06 measures this by READING the bootstrap script rather than by trusting this field.
